cases.prompt: Help me manage my Claude skills across Codex and Cursor too. I want one reusable source instead of copying edits between tools. What should I do first?
cases.expected: Select skillset; suggest an inspection or preview and distinguish source compilation from installation.

cases.prompt: Our repo has skillset.yaml and .skillset/. Generated Claude and Cursor rules drifted after somebody edited the outputs. How should we repair this?
cases.expected: Select skillset; inspect drift and reconcile through source/repair, preserving hand edits until reviewed.

cases.prompt: How do I change which model Claude Code uses for this chat?
cases.expected: Do not select skillset or suggest creating a workspace for generic provider configuration.

cases.prompt: How do I change my Cursor editor color theme?
cases.expected: Do not select skillset or suggest creating a workspace for editor preferences.

cases.prompt: I need a disposable instruction file for one Claude session. It will never be reused or shared with another tool. What is the simplest approach?
cases.expected: Prefer direct provider-native guidance; do not require Skillset adoption. Loading the skill is permitted if the final decision honors the one-off boundary.

cases.prompt: I have an AGENTS.md and a .claude directory. Should I move them into a shared source setup?
cases.expected: Inspect or ask about reuse and provider scope before recommending migration; filenames alone must not authorize adoption. Skill selection is optional, but the decision boundary must be explicit.
